The `source` URL is predictable and based on versioned release assets. While this is third-party repackaging, the process is transparent and the source is pinned to a specific hash. learnings: Binary artifacts (.pkg.tar.zst) are correctly skipped when pinned by checksum - this is appropriate behavior since the checksum closes the swap risk
Models correctly distinguish between packaging style/hygiene and actual injection risks - no false positives on 'violates best practices' reasoning
Tool errors (403/429) should be tracked separately from audit findings to avoid polluting verdict statistics
